title: The enrollment token list read every 403 as a role denial through the generic page failure mapping, so a missing or unknown reason, csrf-token-invalid included, showed No access instead of unavailable
resolution: readPagesUpTo takes the mapping of a failed page; the list maps a 403 as a denial only for role-required and any other 403 as unavailable on every page; the board keeps failureOf; adapter tests of four 403 bodies on the first page and three on a later page.

title: The no-answer issue notice said that a token missing from the list was not issued, though the list holds only pending tokens and may be cut short
resolution: The notice says a token may have been issued without its secret shown, that an unexpected pending token may be it, and that one missing from the list may still have been issued; model test of the text and page tests after a truncated and an emptied list.

title: An owner-to-owner session change kept the section mounted, so an open reveal stayed visible and a late 201 of the earlier operator's command could show its secret to the new one
resolution: WorkersPage keys the section by signedInGeneration, so a new sign-in mounts a fresh section, and the hook drops an answer that settles under another generation; page tests of an open reveal and a deferred 201 across the change and a hook test with the hook kept mounted.

title: The replacement link was decided from the list shown before the command, while the refresh the answer asked for was still pending
resolution: A snapshot refresh marks the shown list as refreshing in the render of the change that asked for it, and the link is offered only from a list not being read again; a deferred-refresh page test and a render-recording useSnapshot test.

title: The command status kept the whole 201 answer with its secret, so closing the reveal left the secret in React state and in the props of the status region
resolution: The status keeps a Notice that names an issued token by its identifier alone, and the secret lives only in the reveal state; hook tests of an issue and a rotation assert no secret in the status or in any returned state after the close; the design states it.

title: The Show it link of a red token notice drew the theme link color on the light red alert at 4.1:1, under the 4.5:1 of the design rules, and the contrast matrix lacked the pair
resolution: The link takes the alert text color, underlined; the matrix gains a link in a red alert for both schemes and a test that the theme link color fails there; the page test checks the link's color and underline.

title: The test titled for a revoke and a rotation never rotated, and no test over the real gateways showed that the one resend carried the renewed CSRF header
resolution: Separate revoke and rotation resend tests, and real-gateway tests of the first and renewed header with the session read between, exactly one resend, a final second refusal, and no resend after leaving or signing out during a held renewal; four mutations fail them.

title: A command denial named the required role twice, the second time with the read wording of the list
resolution: The status region shows the model text, which names the role once; page tests assert the whole denial text of an issue and a revoke.

title: The token status region took the whole commands object, so its props held the revealed secret while the dialog was open, against the reveal state being its only holder
resolution: CommandNotice takes the notice, a busy flag, whether a reveal is open, the listed identifiers, and the retry and refresh callbacks, so no prop of it holds the secret.

title: A replaced token's notice called the replacement still pending even after the refreshed list no longer held it
resolution: The notice says the token was replaced by the replacement and adds that it is still pending, with the Show it link, only while the settled list holds it; page tests of a held, a missing, and a still-refreshing list.

title: The no-answer notices said the control plane did not answer, though they also follow a 5xx, a 403 without a documented reason, and a malformed 201
resolution: The issue, rotate, and revoke no-answer notices say that the control plane gave no usable answer, as the spec delta words it; model and page tests of the texts.

title: The hostname error of the issue form stayed on a corrected field until the next submit
resolution: The hostname field clears its error in onChange, and the submit no longer clears it; a page test types an invalid hostname, submits, and expects the error gone after one edit.

title: A 201 that settles after another sign-in is dropped silently, minting a token whose secret nobody saw, and the records named the drop but not this consequence
resolution: The design's Risks and the record's Limitations state that such a token is minted without a shown secret or a notice and that the new operator sees it only after a refresh.

title: The confirmation dialog mirrored its prop into state through an effect, so the first commit of an opening dialog had an empty title and no question
resolution: ConfirmDialog keeps the last question by setting its state during render when a new confirmation arrives, so an opening dialog never commits empty and the closing transition keeps the question.

title: Close anyway was a red light button inside a red light alert, both on the same background with a transparent border, so the destructive action had no visible boundary at rest
resolution: The close question keeps its red alert for the title and text, and Keep open and Close anyway sit below it on the dialog's surface, the danger light pair of the contrast matrix; a page test expects both buttons outside the alert.

title: The platform and architecture selects used literal options and cast their values, so a new wire enum value would silently miss the form
resolution: The options come from the exported PLATFORMS and ARCHITECTURES of workers-wire.ts and the choice is narrowed with isPlatform and isArchitecture; a page test pins the options and choosing Any again.

title: A reveal test was titled as keeping the earlier owner's notice while it asserted that notice absent
resolution: The test is titled as dropping the reveal when another owner signs in, with the earlier one's notice not reaching the new owner.

title: No test clicked outside the reveal, and the Escape test passed even if Escape opened the close question, so removing either close option kept the suite green
resolution: An overlay-click test and a stronger Escape test expect the dialog open and no close question; each fails when its closeOnClickOutside or closeOnEscape option is removed.

title: No requirement covered the installation-owner gate of the token list or its failed reads, including the 403 rule of pass 1 finding 1
resolution: The delta adds Web SPA enrollment tokens access, 404 characters, with scenarios for the gate, a 403 role-required, and the unavailable list, all already tested.

title: The design credited the CSRF check before the body to routes.ts, while answerRoute of api-server.ts authenticates, checks the CSRF token, then the role, and only then reads the body
resolution: Risks cites answerRoute of apps/control-plane/src/api/api-server.ts and its order.

title: Decision 7 said the light variant draws red.9 on red.0, while Mantine 9.7.4 uses red.1, and omitted that red.9 also drives the dark scheme's red light background and hover
resolution: Decision 7 names red.1 and red.2 for the light scheme and the darkened red.9 background and hover of the dark scheme.

title: The code reads the token list again only after answers that changed it, not after every settled command as Q8 (a) words it, and the design did not list this as a departure
resolution: Departures records that the list is not read after a denial, a 400, a final CSRF refusal, a session read without an answer, a changed sign-in, or no answer, and why.

title: The author self-check gave the secret requirement as 436 characters, though it is 456 since pass 1
resolution: The self-check gives the four added requirements at 484, 456, 480, and 404 characters and when the secret requirement was 436.

title: route.json named headCommit 1096ba7c, a commit not on the branch, while the record said it was regenerated at 8e5338bc
resolution: The record names 1096ba7c as a temporary commit equal to 8e5338bc without the old route.json; the route after the pass 2 fixes has headCommit 059b25fd on the branch.
